messages:
sarah: Quick sync — planning launch for TinkerKit (mini refapp + 3 short tutorials) next week. Need final benchmark narrative, webinar slot, and inbound routing. Can we lock messaging by EOD?

devin: I can finalise the benchmark blurb. quick Q — which metrics are we pushing? latency/cost per 1k tokens or throughput? :thinking_face:

maria: I'd lead the webinar plan. Prefer Wed 10am PT. Gives teams time to prep assets.

ajay: For inbound, let's route leads to the mini-refapp funnel with UTM tags + signup form that triggers dev-eng workflows. I'll add a zap to Segment.

kevin: Draft of hero copy for launch post:
"TinkerKit: A tiny, production-oriented refapp for fast LLM inference — includes tutorials, benchmarked configs, and deploy templates. Ship an interactive demo in under 30 minutes."

tia: Love it. Can we have two variants: one dev-focused (code-first) and one product-focused (outcomes)? I'll sketch CTAs.

devin: Benchmark narrative: emphasize real-world throughput and cost tradeoffs. Key bullets:
- 99th p50 latency at typical query sizes
- tokens/sec and $/1M tokens estimates
- comparison vs public cloud endpoints (same family)
I'll drop numbers into the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1example

sarah: @devin please add a short TL;DR paragraph at top we can reuse for tweet thread.

kevin: Draft tweet thread snippet:

```
TinkerKit → tiny reference app for LLM inference.
1/ See how to run a latency-first and cost-first config.
2/ Benchmarks: <summary stat> tokens/sec, <$X>/1k tokens.
3/ Hands-on tutorial + deploy template. Try the demo: https://tinkerkit.example.com
```

maria: Webinar outline — 30m demo, 15m Q&A, collect attendee feedback via short poll. Speakers: @maria (PM), @sarah (engineer), @ajay (platform). Promote 1 week before launch with 2 reminder emails.

ajay: Routing: create a dedicated inbound tag `tinkerkit_launch_2025`. Integrations: HubSpot for MQLs, Intercom for product pings. I can wire the tracking by Tue.

tia: Messaging variations to A/B test on landing page:
- Variant A: "Ship a demo in 30 minutes" (developer copy)
- Variant B: "Reduce inference cost while maintaining latency" (platform/pm copy)
I'll prepare analytics events.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish checklist due 1738210000 (UTC) — contributors: sarah, devin, maria.

sarah: Actions: devin add numbers to doc, kevin finalize hero copy, tia prepare CTAs + tests, ajay wire routing. I'll assemble launch post and send draft by EOD. Anything else?

kevin: I'll add screenshots & small benchmark graph.

maria: I'll create webinar registration page and calendar invite.

devin: Done — added initial numbers. Link updated.

sarah: Great — thanks team :tada: Let's reconvene tomorrow 9am PT if needed.
